key_insight: H²R uses hierarchical mathematical hints as intermediate milestones in reinforcement learning to shorten the reasoning horizon for complex problems.
engineering_relevance: Structuring verifiable math tasks into reliable sub-question checkpoints can provide richer training guidance than final-answer rewards alone.
method: Leverage intrinsic sub-question structure to construct hierarchical hints.
Use hints as intermediate conditioning signals within reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards.
Evaluate reasoning on HiMath, a benchmark of hierarchically structured mathematical problems.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports Qwen2.5-Math-7B accuracy on HiMath rising from 30.4% to 39.1% using hierarchical hints with H²R, and to 45.6% with Oracle Hierarchical Hints.
watch_item: Practical gains may depend on access to reliable hierarchical hints; oracle-hint results do not establish performance with automatically generated hints.
paper_title: H$^2$R: Hierarchical Hint-Based Reward for Mathematical Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
